name: PImage
desc: Datatype for storing and manipulating images. Load with loadImage() or create with createImage().
syntax:
PImage* img = loadImage("file.png")
PImage* img = createImage(w, h, ARGB)

methods.name: pixels[]
methods.desc: Array of color values for the image

methods.name: width
methods.desc: Width of the image in pixels

methods.name: height
methods.desc: Height of the image in pixels

methods.name: set(int x, int y, color c)
